preserved_state.name: ritual_focus
preserved_state.rule: The original centered Evening Ritual composition remains a dedicated focus state entered from the prioritized Today list. It is not the default list layout.

read_model.rule: The client renders the server-composed order and never derives missed, needs-review, acknowledgement or relationship-day state from the device clock or cache.

priority_contract.default_behavior: Render at most three priority items. Later/optional items remain behind one count-bearing disclosure row.
priority_contract.expanded_behavior: Expand Later inline in server order. The body scrolls; page header and bottom navigation remain stable. Show all remaining items up to the ten-item daily limit and preserve state/action availability per item.
priority_contract.collapse_behavior: Return to the same scroll anchor and keep the first three priorities unchanged.
priority_contract.overflow_behavior: More than ten items is a server/read-model contract violation; do not silently truncate or create client-side pagination.

item_contract.action_rule: The server supplies allowed actions. Basic understanding and these four paths must not require opening a detail page.
item_contract.visual_rule: The first priority receives editorial emphasis; items two and three use disciplined timeline rows. Later items use compact rows and never become a wall of equal cards.

default.meaning: Server-confirmed Today with three visible priorities and five collapsed later items.

expanded.meaning: Eight-item example with all five later items expanded inline.

loading.meaning: Resolve authorization, membership and current Today read model without revealing stale partner content.

empty.meaning: Server confirms no actionable priority or later item for the relationship day; optional check-in remains non-urgent.

error_retry.meaning: Current truth cannot be loaded and no safe confirmed cache is available. Hide sensitive content and offer explicit retry.

offline.meaning: Show only the last confirmed cached list with timestamp. All mutations are disabled until server confirmation returns.

authorization_loss.meaning: Remove all partner and Dynamic content, clear the protected view and offer sign-in recovery.

role_variant.meaning: Dominant, submissive, Switch and custom contexts keep identical hierarchy and agency controls; only approved personal-title/context copy may vary.

solo.meaning: Solo Dynamic uses the same Today grammar, replaces partner presence with explicit private context and contains no human-response module.

stale_refresh.meaning: After a stale version or stale mutation response, replace the list with server current truth and announce that Today changed; never preserve a locally inferred state.

role_and_agency.attention_boundary: Human work created by the viewer for the partner belongs in Attention. Today remains the viewer's receiving/action surface regardless of role label.

build_gate_effect: none until candidate approval, copy/platform confirmation and remaining product gates are resolved
